page.layout: One page of text, two oval woodcut portraits at the top, running text below in one column. No margin notes, no notes below the text.

main_text.l: PLATO Philosophus Ariftone Patricio inter Athenien-
fes ciue,& Periεtiona fiue Prona natus eft.claruit circa annum
mundi 3575. ante Chriftum natum 387. à corporis habitu
egregio, Plato dictus eft, aut ab orationis vbertate & mira
amplitudine, cùm prius Ariftocles ex aui nomine diceretur:
20.annos natus, Poëticam miro complexus eft ingenio: cele-
bratas Tragœdias, atque alia carmina fcripfit, fuauíque vocis
fono pronuntiauit,nisi quòd ad gracilitatem tenderet. Poftea
Philofophiam amplexatus, Poëticam reliquit: Socratis difci-
pulus fuit, & Ariftotelis ac Xenocratis præceptor. Ter milita-
uit,egregiúmque militem fe præftitit. Ter in Siciliam naviga-
uit: tertiò rediens,venundatus,atque à Dionyfio Tyranno ex-
trema penè paffus eft. In Ægypto didicit quæcunq; illic magna
habebantur. Philofophiam in moralem,naturalem,& rationa-
lem diftribuit. Varia de eius morte fcribuntur. Vixit annos 8o.
Vide Dioge.Laër.libr.3. Auguft.de ciuit.Dei lib.8.ca.4. & Plu-
tar.in eius vita.
ARISTOTELES patre Nicomacho medico,natus eft
in obfcuro oppido Stagira: vbi adoleuit, Athenas ftudiorum
gratia miffus eft. Platonem audiuit annos 2 o.Deinde in Ma-
cedoniam euocatus à Philippo, & Alexandro filio in difcipli-
nam tradito, maximam autoritatem in regno promeruit. hu-
ius fcripta extant quàm plurima, quæ vel ad eloquentiam fpe-
ftant, vel ad ciuilem, moralémque difciplinam, vel ad fecre-
ta naturæ. Dioge.Laër.lib.5.Plutar.in eius vita.

page.notes: Two oval woodcut portraits above the text: left inscribed "PLATO" and "ΦΗΣ" (Greek, as printed, partly unclear); right inscribed "ARISTOTELES" and "STAGIRITES". The "ARISTOTELES" opening line is set in spaced capitals and treated as a paragraph opener. Possible printing irregularity: "Periεtiona" is printed with a Greek-looking letter for "ct" and is copied as printed; the ο in "Ariftone" etc. is as printed. Some letters in the running head and page number are faint.
